validation_notes: Processed 4 people for ticker FIVE. Checked 2 local documents in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/FIVE before web search. Completed 1 research round for each person, 4 total person rounds, plus one orchestrator overview. CEO is confirmed as Igor Shekhterman in the 2024 context. Education was confirmed for all four people, though Ivan Vorona's education relies on professional training biographies rather than university pages. Weak/non-primary sources used: TopTrening and IIA/IVA for Ivan Vorona biography; CFO Russia for Murashkin pre-2019 career summary; these are supported where possible by official issuer-report role context. Conflicts: CSV company name reflects X5 Retail Group N.V., while 2024 local documents identify ПАО «Корпоративный центр ИКС 5» after 01.07.2024; annual report pages differ on the end date of executive-body powers (30.06.2025 vs 30.07.2025), so the JSON does not depend on the end date. Namesakes excluded: unconfirmed academic/publication profile for Ivan Nikolaevich Vorona at VAVT, historical/unrelated Vorona/Murashkin results, Wikipedia/Ruwiki summaries, Instagram/social snippets, and employee-review pages. Search considered complete because local PDFs, official issuer reports, official/business biographies, education queries, previous-employer queries, appointment queries, professional biography queries, publications/patents/h-index queries, and namesake checks were completed; no unresolved high-quality lead remained. ROUND 2 (gap-filling + GICS + qualification_degree + institution normalization, this session): (1) Gap-filling -- re-checked local filings first (full-text scan of both MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/FIVE PDFs for Kontakt, Investment Construction Holding, AlfaStrakhovanie, Rosvodokanal, BearingPoint, PwC/Coca-Cola/Cargill, EY, Petrovich, Vorona and Murashkin name strings -- no hits beyond an unrelated AlfaStrakhovanie mention in a loyalty-program context), then re-fetched the specific previously-cited web sources directly (retail.ru for Shekhterman/Kontakt; kommersant.ru and x5.praxisgroup.ru for Lobacheva/Investment Construction Holding; iva-edu.ru and toptrening.ru for Vorona/PwC-Coca-Cola-Cargill/AlfaStrakhovanie-Rosvodokanal dates; cfo-russia.ru and risk-practice.ru for Murashkin/EY years and pre-2019 retail employers). None of these re-fetches surfaced a role/date/employer detail beyond what round 1 already captured, so the following fields remain deliberately null, now confirmed as dead ends rather than unexamined gaps: Shekhterman's Kontakt role; Lobacheva's Investment Construction Holding role/dates; Vorona's PwC/Coca-Cola/Cargill and AlfaStrakhovanie/Rosvodokanal dates; Murashkin's EY years and the identity of the unnamed retail employers 2011-2019. New unrestricted web search (beyond re-fetching already-known URLs) was not available this round because the session's web-search quota was exhausted; no field was guessed to compensate for this, per the project's prefer-null-over-guess rule. (2) sector/industry_group/industry were added at company level (Consumer Staples / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name) / Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name), matching X5 Group's core grocery-retail business) and to every professional_experience entry for all four people, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json. Each organization was classified by its own primary business: X5/ПАО «Корпоративный центр ИКС 5» entities as Consumer Staples retail; RosExpert and Kontakt (executive search/recruitment) and BearingPoint and EY (consulting/professional services) as Industrials / Commercial & Professional Services / Professional Services; Beoluna (Japanese jewellery producer) as Consumer Discretionary / Consumer Durables & Apparel / Textiles, Apparel & Luxury Goods; EvrazHolding as Materials / Materials / Metals & Mining; MDM Bank as Financials / Banks / Banks; STD Petrovich (building-materials/DIY retail chain) as Consumer Discretionary / Consumer Discretionary Distribution & Retail (New Name) / Specialty Retail. Three entries were left all-null with an explanation because a single GICS triple could not be supported: Lobacheva's 'Investment Construction Holding' (generic label, no specific legal entity identified); Vorona's combined PwC/Coca-Cola/Cargill entry (three organizations with different primary businesses combined in one entry); Vorona's combined AlfaStrakhovanie/Rosvodokanal audit-committee entry (insurance vs. water utility, different GICS sectors); Murashkin's generic 'Retail companies' entry (no specific employer named). (3) qualification_degree was added to every education[] and degrees[] entry using only the ten allowed values or null. Explicit degree titles were mapped directly (Bachelor's degree for Shekhterman's and Vorona's bachelor's degrees; Specialist degree for Vorona's and Murashkin's specialist-level Soviet/Russian qualifications and for Lobacheva's first RANEPA-branch law degree, reflecting the pre-Bologna five-year single-tier structure; MBA for Vorona's and Lobacheva's Executive MBA programmes at Chicago Booth and IMD; Professional certification for Vorona's CIA; Doctoral degree for Murashkin's Candidate of Economic Sciences, consistent with the Candidate-of-Sciences to Doctoral-degree mapping already used elsewhere in this dataset, e.g. DIAS). Three entries were left null because the source language does not state an explicit degree level and no independent confirmation could be found this round: Shekhterman's Institute d'Administration des Enterprises and Danish Management School entries (described only as 'general management and financial management', consistent with either an executive-education programme or a postgraduate degree, not distinguishable with high confidence), and Lobacheva's second Plekhanov Finance-and-Credit education entry (2013 is inside Russia's completed Bachelor's/Specialist-mix transition period and the source does not state which). (4) Institution names were normalized to their canonical university_names.json form: 'ГОУ ВПО «Поволжская академия государственной службы имени П. А. Столыпина»' and 'Поволжская академия государственной службы имени П. А. Столыпина' -> 'Российская академия народного хозяйства и государственной службы при Президенте Российской Федерации'; 'Российский экономический университет имени Г. В. Плеханова' -> 'Российский экономический университет имени Г.В. Плеханова' (punctuation-only normalization); 'Дальневосточный государственный университет' -> 'Дальневосточный федеральный университет'; 'Chicago Booth' -> 'University of Chicago Booth School of Business'. All four raw strings were already listed as exact aliases in university_names.json, so new_institutions_found for this ticker is an empty list -- no institution outside the reference file was encountered. All other institution strings (Kaliningrad State Technical University, Institute d'Administration des Enterprises, Danish Management School, IMD Business School, University of Maryland University College, Novgorod State University named after Yaroslav the Wise) already matched their canonical entries verbatim and were left unchanged.
